spiral_method.forward_pass: historical development created names, modules and experiments while context was local and fragmented

spiral_method.ascend_rule: A repeated pass must add resolution or a falsification boundary; it must not merely repeat the same search.
spiral_method.boundary: High-coverage search over currently available Library artifacts and Hawkar-usls GitHub state is not a mathematical guarantee that every historical byte or mention has been recovered.

real_input.important_loss: the H(z) error column is parsed but discarded; no uncertainty propagation is performed

hologpt_test2_audit.manufactured_target_problem: The model's hidden vectors are not observed hidden cosmological states; they are created by extending observed H(z)/Planck vectors with deterministic combinations plus random noise.
hologpt_test2_audit.holdout_problem: test_seqs are selected directly from train_seqs[-5:], so evaluation is not on an independent holdout corpus.
hologpt_test2_audit.null_control: No explicit shuffled/null-control benchmark is implemented in the complete inspected 451-line source.
hologpt_test2_audit.threshold_problem: evaluate_holography uses fixed median-discrepancy threshold 0.1 without calibration or null-derived significance in the inspected source.
hologpt_test2_audit.training_loop_issue: train_on_sequences accepts steps_per_epoch but the inspected implementation performs one random train_step per epoch and does not use steps_per_epoch; caller passes 30 but this does not create 30 updates per epoch.
hologpt_test2_audit.fallback_provenance_problem: If real H(z) download fails, build_holo_sequences silently falls back to synthetic demo sequences while the main banner/flow still describes the experiment as real-data cosmology.
hologpt_test2_audit.overclaim: A positive internal verdict prints that the Universe is holographic; the design does not support that inference.
